Title: What's happening on the transfer market ?

Posts.Title: What's happening on the transfer market ?
Posts.Text:
A few years ago, it wasn't easy to find a top player at a resonable price.
But now, it's almost impossible !!

Less players on the market, and higher prices.
I understand that it's all about offer and demand. But every thing is going crazy.

So i said, maybe i should invest in my youth academy and train a top class players.
But all i get each season is rubbish young players, i fire most of them.

Posts.Text: People got more money in the bank. Good players will always go for a lot of money. Thats the big diffrence with the youth system compared to the one we had 2019. Good players will go for a lot of money, average players cost a dime because everyone can develop players like that.
